description: This is a test class for HibernateAlertDAO in the OpenMRS project, verifying CRUD operations and alert retrieval logic for Hibernate-based data access objects.

classes.name: HibernateAlertDAOTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for HibernateAlertDAO, extending BaseContextSensitiveTest to ensure context is available during tests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data and updates alert expiration date once before each test.

methods.name: saveAlert_shouldSaveAlertToDb
methods.description: Tests saving a new alert and verifies persistence.

methods.name: getAlert_shouldGetAlertById
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a specific alert by ID.

methods.name: deleteAlert_shouldReturnNullAfterDeleting
methods.description: Ensures that after deletion, the alert is no longer retrievable.

methods.name: getAllAlerts_shouldReturnOnlyNonExpiredAllerts
methods.description: Checks that only non-expired alerts are returned.

methods.name: getAlerts_shouldReturnAllAlertsWhenUserIsSpecified
methods.description: Verifies alert retrieval when filtered by user.
